API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIServer ManagementDeletes the Server for the specified ID.
Deletes the Server for the specified ID.
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/server/:serverId

Deletes the Server for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

serverId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Server.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the Microtenant for the ZPA tenant. If you are within the Default Microtenant, pass microtenantId as 0 when making requests to retrieve data from the Default Microtenant. Pass microtenantId as null to retrieve data from all customers associated with the tenant.

Responses
​
204
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

No Content
